usage: These are INPUTS only, not labeled ground truth. Run each case through your real pipeline (analyzeIntake -> generateDraft -> critiqueDraft) and record the actual output. For cases with an expectedDomain, compare it against analyzeIntake's real classification to score classification accuracy. For all cases, have a human score the actual generated draft against the 4-axis rubric (hook/authenticity/domainGrounding/structure) plus fabricationFlag/contrarianBaitFlag from critique-schema-fix.ts. That human score, paired with the critic's real verdict, is what validates the critic -- these inputs alone are not that.

cases.topic: PostgreSQL index bloat and zero-downtime VACUUM in production
cases.context: Ran into severe index bloat on a hot table after months of high-churn writes. Fixed it with pg_repack instead of a blocking VACUUM FULL, with zero downtime.
cases.notes: Baseline known-good case, mirrors the one already used in verify:llm.
